detail: Krishna Kumar Choudhary submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The filing initiates the open offer process and sets off a defined timeline for completion under SEBI supervision.
